description: Compose repos for the fleet. A version fragment is any compose file whose name ends in dev.yml or prod.yml, wherever it lives in the repo. CI deploys a merge to that tier's hosts.

packageRules.description: dev tier soaks for three days, prod keeps the seven above
dev tier also merges minors itself, so dev runs a release before prod is asked
prod updates get their own branch, so a held prod minor cannot block the dev automerge of the same release
A 0.x minor may break under semver, so it stays a pull request even on dev
Neo4j stays on the 5.26 LTS line; the calendar releases are a migration, not an update
Neo4j is stateful and a rollback cannot undo a store upgrade: prod is never automerged, dev is the canary
